breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains both contradictory instructions: 'Use a gamma-centered k-point grid' AND 'Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift and a density equivalent to a 6x6x6 grid for the primitive cell.' The ground truth resolves this by specifying only a gamma-centered k-point grid, removing any mention of a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh. The agent failed to eliminate the conflicting half-shift instruction.
